annotations.title: The best current jobs for a CV

description: Job Spotter. The best current jobs for a CV. For "find jobs that fit my CV", "what jobs should I apply for?". Searches current jobs for the person's target roles (or past titles) and place, and ranks them by match score, with matched and missing skills for each. Nothing sent is stored. The score is a fixed formula, not an AI judgement; the person decides what to apply for.

cv.description: The CV as plain text. Optional if titles and skills are given.

employers.description: Current and past employers, comma separated.

location.description: Where the person lives or wants to work.

target_roles.description: Roles to look for, comma separated. Defaults to the CV's titles.

titles.description: Current and past job titles, comma separated.

where.description: Where to look, for example London or remote.

name: jobspotter_jobs_for_me
